## Summary

All equations (1-4), Algorithm 1, and hierarchical backoff verified against production code.

---

## Equation Verification

| Equation | Paper Reference | Implementation | File | Status |
|----------|-----------------|----------------|------|--------|
| Eq. 1: Context Vector | phi^(k)(x_t) = S_k({y_s : s in N_k(t)}) | StatsAggregator.aggregate() | stats.py | OK |
| Eq. 2: Concatenation | Phi(x_t) = [phi^(1), ..., phi^(K)] | compute_aggregations() + transform() | stats.py, engine.py | OK |
| Eq. 3: Relative Features | r_{k}(x_t) = (y_t - mu_k) / sigma_k | compute_relative_features() - **DISABLED** | stats.py | OK |
| Eq. 4: Cross-fitting | Out-of-fold aggregation | _fit_transform_cross_fitted() | engine.py | OK |

---

## Algorithm 1 Verification

| Step | Description | Implementation | Status |
|------|-------------|----------------|--------|
| 1 | Partition indices into M folds | KFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True) | OK |
| 2 | For each fold, compute stats on out-of-fold data | Loop in _fit_transform_cross_fitted() | OK |
| 3 | Apply stats to in-fold observations | transform() with stored stats | OK |
| 4 | Concatenate all levels | Feature prefix naming | OK |

---

## Leakage Prevention

| Risk Vector | Status | Notes |
|-------------|--------|-------|
| Cross-fitting | OK | KFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42) |
| Relative features | OK | Disabled by default (causes y_t leakage) |
| Global stats | OK | Computed out-of-fold when cross-fitting enabled |
| Transform phase | OK | Uses training statistics only |

---

## Extensions Beyond Paper

| Feature | Implementation | Purpose |
|---------|----------------|---------|
| Fold Variance | _aggregate_fold_statistics() | Uncertainty quantification |
| Global Statistics | include_global_stats=True | Dataset-wide context |
| Interaction Features | include_interactions=True | Cross-column hierarchies |
| Extended Quantiles | Q05, Q10, Q20, Q33, Q66, Q80, Q90, Q95 | Richer distribution capture |
